States that if LOGTAIL_TOKEN is not set logtail cannot read the token, so set it in the same terminal session before running
Explanation that `--follow` keeps logtail open and shows new lines as they are appended to the file
Note that if LOGTAIL_TOKEN is not set, logtail cannot read the token, and it must be set in the same terminal session before running
